  • Blood (Kainai)↗Continuing community institution location
    Connection & source
    Continuing community institution location

    Actual Kainai Board of Education declaration identifies Blood Indian Nation; institution address is Stand Off, Alberta. Institution/community link, not all ancestral lands.

    Selected geography passage inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

  • Chipewyan↗Specific present day First Nations listed in provincial directory
    Connection & source
    Specific present day First Nations listed in provincial directory

    Under its Alberta First Nations introduction and Treaty-territory directory, the province lists Athabasca Chipewyan First Nation and Chipewyan Prairie First Nation. These named governments establish a specific Alberta community connection for the Chipewyan access point.

    Provincial directory content inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

  • Siksika↗Present community connection

  • Stoney Nakoda↗Shared council contact location
    Connection & source
    Shared council contact location

    The Nations identify Bearspaw, Chiniki and Goodstoney as separate First Nations and publish their shared council contact in Mini Thni, Alberta. No outdated individual leadership term is treated as current.

    Public content inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.
